message:
Patch Set 5:

PS5 on top of PS4: fixes for the in-tree BOLT build and the standalone llvm-tools-subpkgs spec. The PS4 history in the commit message is unchanged; a summary of the PS5 changes follows it.

BOLT CMake
- Add BOLT_LLVM_LINK_MODE, set before its consumers in bolt/CMakeLists.txt. It is empty only when BOLT is built standalone with LLVM_LINK_LLVM_DYLIB=ON, and DISABLE_LLVM_LINK_LLVM_DYLIB otherwise. All BOLT libraries, tools and unit tests use it, so in-tree BOLT keeps linking the LLVM component libraries as before, and only the standalone dylib build links libLLVM.so.
- X86BoltMnemonicTables.cpp is listed in LLVM_OPTIONAL_SOURCES and compiled only for standalone dylib builds; the mirror declarations are enabled under the same condition.
- The inherited runtime C/C++ flags are cleared only for standalone builds; in-tree runtime flags are unchanged.
- merge-fdata is installed once by CMake; the duplicate manual install is removed.

llvm.spec
- armv7l LLVM_TARGETS_TO_BUILD is back to ARM;BPF.
- The explicit Requires: python3 on llvm is removed.

llvm-tools-subpkgs.spec
- ExclusiveArch: x86_64 aarch64, with BOLT_TARGETS_TO_BUILD set per architecture and a check that the expected targets are registered.
- The LLVM provider BuildRequires (llvm, llvm-devel, llvm-static-devel, libllvm, libomp) are pinned to %{version}, and %build checks that the installed providers share one version and release.
- bolt now requires libllvm = %{version} at runtime (unversioned in PS4); its explicit Requires: compiler-rt is removed.
- LLVM_LIBDIR_SUFFIX is derived from %{_lib} instead of a fixed 64.
- The distribution $LDFLAGS are kept in the CMake linker flags, together with --build-id=sha1.
- The debug packaging comment now describes the actual flow (find-debuginfo via __debug_install_post, bolt-debuginfo and llvm-tools-subpkgs-debugsource).

Tested on x86_64: full llvm build with in-tree BOLT, and a standalone llvm-tools-subpkgs build against the installed llvm packages.

Uploaded patch set 6.

Outdated Votes:
* Code-Review+1 (copy condition: "changekind:NO_CHANGE OR is:MIN")
* Verified+1 (copy condition: "changekind:NO_CHANGE")

Patch Set 5:

Review of PS5 (no vote).

Blocking-ish, addressed in PS6:
1. packaging/llvm.spec: "Obsoletes: clang-analyzer" is on the llvm package, but the analyzer libexec scripts (ccc-analyzer, c++-analyzer, intercept-cc, ...) are owned by the clang package. The obsolete belongs on clang, and the comment "llvm takes them over" is inaccurate for those files.
2. packaging/llvm.spec: analyze-build, intercept-build, scan-build and scan-build-py are in the llvm %files, but they run the libexec scripts that ship from clang. Installing llvm alone leaves them non-functional. clang already Requires llvm, so moving them to clang avoids the cycle the comment was trying to avoid.

Non-blocking:
3. llvm.spec %install comment says the openmp libgomp/libiomp5 symlinks land in $DESTDIR/usr/lib. The openmp install rule writes to $DESTDIR${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/${OPENMP_INSTALL_LIBDIR} (lib64 on 64-bit). The rm uses %{_libdir}, which matches that path, so only the comment is off.
4. Commit message lists items that are already in the base (ARM;BPF target list, LLVM_LIBDIR_SUFFIX derivation, dropped python3 Requires) and not changes in this patchset. Worth rewording to describe what this change does.
5. bolt/lib/Target/X86/X86GenSubSuperRegisterBody.inc and X86GenNeedsAddressSizeOverrideBody.inc match the upstream bodies in f346dd75 (ignoring whitespace). Minor: the #define macros in X86BoltMnemonicTables.cpp are not #undef'd, and the is16BitMemOperand signature continuation is misaligned.

Not verified: no gbs build. Before submit, please confirm on the built libLLVM.so.22.1 that X86::isNOP / getX86SubSuperRegister / needsAddressSizeOverride are not exported (nm -D --defined-only), otherwise the X86 mirror duplicates symbols.

Patch Set 6:

Review of PS6 (no vote).

Addresses items 1 and 2 from the PS5 review:
- clang-analyzer Obsoletes moved from llvm to clang; the llvm comment is corrected.
- analyze-build, intercept-build, scan-build and scan-build-py moved from the llvm %files to the clang %files. clang already Requires llvm, so there is no cycle.
- llvm-tools-subpkgs.spec description updated to match the new ownership.

Verified: the spec parses (rpmspec -q --srpm exits 0) and the diff has no whitespace errors. No gbs build yet.

Non-blocking items 3-5 from the PS5 review are not addressed in this patchset.
